name: How long does a post-concussion syndrome personal injury case take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a post-concussion syndrome personal injury case take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a post-concussion syndrome personal injury case can vary significantly. Factors influencing the timeline include the severity of your injuries, the complexity of medical evidence, the willingness of the at-fault party's insurance company to negotiate, and court schedules if a lawsuit is filed. Some cases settle in a few months, while others, particularly those involving more severe or long-lasting PCS symptoms, can take several years to resolve through litigation. Your attorney will provide a more specific estimate based on your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Case duration varies widely based on injury severity, evidence complexity, insurance cooperation, and court schedules, ranging from months to several years.
